observation.description: The safe generated pagination path (defineOwnedKeysetPages, with its opaque AEAD cursor, byte-uniform refusals, and no-skip/no-dup continuation guarantee) accepts only visibility {kind:'owner'} — a partition field matched against the caller's principal. The A3 board's PRIMARY list shape — all issues in an organization/team, visible to any member — cannot use it: the partition is a resource id, not a principal. Combined with 0137-a2-f5 (the packaged ctx.db chain has no strict-greater keyset verb), an org-partition cursor must be hand-rolled over a bounded indexed read with client-side boundary exclusion, forfeiting the cursor custody the generated path provides. The arm shipped both: the generated pages for 'my issues' (passed, including cross-owner cursor refusals) and a hand-rolled org-wide cursor (honest at seed scale only).

competitorOutcome.description: Convex paginated queries (.paginate over any index) serve arbitrary partitions inside membership-gated functions with journal-backed cursors; the frozen Linear arm paginated the team's issue list natively.

mustNotRegress: Cursor custody: opaque versioned continuations bound to app, plan pair, and authority partition, refusing malformed/cross-pair/cross-authority presentations byte-uniformly; generation keeps rejecting scan-disguising declarations.
smallestCoherentFix: Extend the keyset-pages generator with a membership-gated resource partition: index [resourceField, cursorField] plus a membership declaration whose resource axis is that field — the cursor binds the resource partition and the caller's seat instead of the principal (this is the bounded-children/board-list shape LLP 0110/0131 already designed for).
acceptanceWitness: A generated first/next pair over (orgId, pageKey) pages the seeded org for any member with the standard cursor refusal matrix, denies the outsider uniformly, and survives interleaved writes without duplication or skips.
